name.description: The deployment's name, unique among its Build's live deployments; null where it has none or comfy-deploy does not serve names yet.

revision.description: The deployment's revision. Present only when deployment updates are on for the workspace.

previousRelease.description: Present only when this run moved an existing deployment onto `release`: the release it served before.

estimate.description: Present only when this run created the deployment and the service could estimate it: how long until ready, in whole seconds, and the model bytes to download. atLeast makes both a floor.

progress.description: Where a deployment that is coming up has got to, exactly as the deploy service sent it. Present only while the status is provisioning or starting; absent otherwise, and from a service that does not send it. The byte fields, bytesPerSecond, etaSeconds and placingModels are present only while step is staging_models. bytesTotal is absent for a release whose models were never measured and 0 when every model is already in place. New fields may appear.

step.description: staging_models, creating_endpoint or waiting_for_worker today; read an unknown value as a step name.

placingModels.description: Present and true once every byte of the models is in and the step is finishing: the models are being put in place and, on Modal, a release image built beside the upload may still be building. It stays true until the step changes, and etaSeconds, where given, counts down what is left. Absent before the last byte, with no byte to move, and from a service that does not send it.

startedAt.description: When this attempt of the step began. How long the step has run is measured from here.

updatedAt.description: When the service last wrote this object. It advances every few seconds in every step, so it says how fresh the sample is, not how long the step has run.
